answer: Keep a public atlas of the attestation graph and force every new identity to anchor to an established member with a slashable bond. Influence travels like a ripple: it decays with each hop, and every graph cluster has a hard cap on total weight. A farm spawning a thousand clones still sits inside one cluster behind one anchor, so it must post a thousand separate bonds to register them yet can never exceed that single cluster cap; when correlated misbehavior is proven, the anchor bond burns together with theirs, making each extra identity pure cost.
